text:
maria: quick flag postmortem. after 3.2.1 mobile rollout we saw token cost up ~6% and KV cache hit-rate drop for short prompts. traced runtime flows and dropping keys seems tied to a client-side default change.
kevin: timeline and symptom summary?
maria: rollout start 1762007890. SDK unintentionally flipped `prefix_cache_enabled` -> false for v3 mobile builds. lots of requests now include `x-redwood-cache: none`.
alex: that header will short-circuit server keying logic. do you have a trace showing kernel/batch effects?
maria: pasted condensed trace below:
```
1762007892 runtime: recv req len=48 tokens, model=gpt-medium
1762007892 cache: client header=none -> SKIP client-keying, server uses coarse route key -> MISS
1762007892 batch: created small batch size=2 (no KV warmups)
1762007892 kernel: selected=fallback_matmul (slower) due to heuristic mismatch
1762007894 kv: insert latency=5.2ms
1762007895 emit: 48 tokens, p50 latency 235ms
1762007920 retry-client: same prefix with header x-redwood-cache=accept -> HIT
```
kevin: missed warmups reduce batching efficiency, which nudges kernel selection to slower paths. we saw p50 latency regress +12% for the affected cohort.
eva: PM changed default for privacy-by-default, but migration note didn't reach mobile. Devex will need a prominent changelog entry.
sam: product: some customers expect opt-out semantics; we need explicit API header with clear modes. proposal: `x-rw-cache-mode: off|opt-in|always` (server-enforced registry for `always`).
alex: short-term mitigations: 1) runtime-level override header `x-redwood-cache-override=true` for trusted apps; 2) tweak kernel-selection thresholds so common short seqs don't pick fallback on older hw.
maria: I've enabled a canary flag runtime.feature.allow_prefix_override and pushed canary to us-east-1 at 1762008000. infra-bot: deploy -> canary/runtime/allow_prefix_override -> us-east-1 (20 instances).
infra-bot: deploy logs: https://deploys.internal/1762008000 (check health).
kevin: also add telemetry tags: `cache_header`, `cache_mode`, `cache_hit`, `kernel_path`, `batch_size` so we can slice impact.
maria: added tags to traces. early canary numbers: hit-rate for override group ~76% (pre-rollout baseline ~79%), overall cohort recovered to ~73% where previously it fell to ~51%. p50 latency improved ~9% for canary.
eva: I'll open SDK PR to add explicit header and a migration guide (examples, how to opt back in). also add a note in mobile release notes.
alex: long-term: move deterministic prefix canonicalization into SDKs (normalize whitespace, template placeholders, stable hashing) so server keying is robust to client-side formatting. plus server nightly job: top-N key entropy detection and alerts for >20% churn week-over-week.
kevin: create tickets: RW-ops#1187 for entropy job, RW-sdk#902 for header + canonicalization RFC, RW-runtime#441 for telemetry dashboard.
sam: agreed. action items: (maria) monitor canary for 24h and report; (kevin) add telemetry and dashboard; (eva) SDK PR + docs; (alex) draft canonicalization RFC. regroup after 24h. :thumbsup:
maria: last check at 1762008250  canary stable, hit-rate ~75%, median latency down vs bad rollout. staying on watch.
